qe: What is the primary purpose of pre-operative skin scrubbing?
qh: प्री-ऑपरेटिव स्किन स्क्रबिंग का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To reduce the microbial count on the skin | त्वचा पर सूक्ष्मजीवों की संख्या कम करना
e: Skin scrubbing with antiseptics reduces transient and resident flora to prevent surgical site infection.

qe: Which position is used for Gallbladder surgery?
qh: पित्ताशय (Gallbladder) की सर्जरी के लिए किस पोजीशन का उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Supine with a sandbag under the right shoulder | दाहिने कंधे के नीचे सैंडबैग के साथ सुपाइन
e: A sandbag or gall bladder bridge helps in better exposure of the upper abdominal area. The sandbag lifts the right side of the abdomen so that the surgeon gets a clear view of the gallbladder under the right costal margin.

qe: The process of placing a sterile sheet over the patient to expose only the surgical site is called:
qh: सर्जिकल साइट को उजागर करने के लिए मरीज पर स्टेराइल शीट बिछाने की प्रक्रिया कहलाती है:
e: Draping creates a sterile field around the incision site to maintain asepsis. Drapes are laid in a fixed order, starting away from the incision and moving towards it, so the team never reaches across an unsterile area.

qe: What is the standard adult dose of 'Adrenaline' (1:1000) given during Cardiac Arrest via IV route?
qh: कार्डियक अरेस्ट के दौरान IV मार्ग से 'एड्रेनालिन' की मानक वयस्क खुराक क्या है?
e: In ACLS protocols, 1mg of Adrenaline is given every 3-5 minutes during resuscitation. / कार्डियक अरेस्ट में हर 3-5 मिनट में 1mg एड्रेनालिन दिया जाता है।

qe: When should the 'Soda Lime' in the CO2 absorber be replaced?
qh: CO2 एब्जॉर्बर में 'सोडा लाइम' को कब बदला जाना चाहिए?
o: When 50-70% of granules change color | जब 50-70% दाने रंग बदल लें
e: Color change (usually to violet/purple) indicates that the soda lime is exhausted and can no longer absorb CO2. / रंग बदलना यह दर्शाता है कि सोडा लाइम अब CO2 नहीं सोख सकता।

qe: Which specific ET tube size is generally used for a 'Full-term Newborn'?
qh: 'फुल-टर्म नवजात' के लिए आमतौर पर किस आकार की ET ट्यूब का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Pediatric patients require much smaller uncuffed or cuffed tubes compared to adults. / बच्चों और नवजात शिशुओं के लिए उनकी आयु के अनुसार छोटे आकार की ट्यूब चाहिए होती है।

qe: Under the 'Consumer Protection Act', what constitutes 'Medical Negligence' by an OT Assistant?
qh: उपभोक्ता संरक्षण अधिनियम के तहत, OT असिस्टेंट द्वारा 'मेडिकल लापरवाही' क्या मानी जाती है?
o: Leaving a mop/instrument inside the patient | मरीज के अंदर मॉप या उपकरण छोड़ देना
e: Failure to count instruments or gauze correctly is a direct legal liability for the OT team. / उपकरणों की गिनती में गलती करना एक गंभीर कानूनी अपराध है।

qe: What is the 'Dermatome' instrument used for in Plastic Surgery?
qh: प्लास्टिक सर्जरी में 'डर्माटोम' उपकरण का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
o: To harvest skin grafts | स्किन ग्राफ्ट निकालने के लिए
e: A dermatome is used to cut thin slices of skin from a donor area for grafting. / यह उपकरण ग्राफ्टिंग के लिए त्वचा की एक समान पतली परत निकालने के काम आता है।

qe: Which vital sign is the most sensitive indicator of 'Hemorrhage' in the early stages?
qh: शुरुआती चरणों में 'रक्तस्राव' का सबसे संवेदनशील संकेतक कौन सा वाइटल साइन है?
o: Increasing Pulse Rate (Tachycardia) | बढ़ती हुई नाड़ी दर
e: The body compensates for blood loss by increasing the heart rate before the blood pressure drops. / रक्तचाप गिरने से पहले शरीर धड़कन बढ़ाकर रक्त की कमी की भरपाई करने की कोशिश करता है।

qe: What is the 'Maintenance' protocol for the Anesthesia Vaporizer?
qh: एनेस्थीसिया वेपोराइज़र के लिए 'रखरखाव' प्रोटोकॉल क्या है?
o: Periodic calibration and leak testing | समय-समय पर कैलिब्रेशन और लीक टेस्टिंग
e: Vaporizers must be accurately calibrated to ensure the correct concentration of gas is delivered. / गैस की सही मात्रा सुनिश्चित करने के लिए वेपोराइज़र की नियमित जांच जरूरी है।

qe: The 'Log book' maintained by an OT Assistant should record:
qh: एक OT असिस्टेंट द्वारा रखी जाने वाली 'लॉग बुक' में क्या दर्ज होना चाहिए?
o: Details of surgeries assisted and equipment used | सहायता की गई सर्जरी और उपकरणों का विवरण
e: A log book is a formal record of a technician's clinical experience and work performed. / लॉग बुक तकनीशियन के दैनिक कार्यों और अनुभव का आधिकारिक प्रमाण है।

qe: In Pediatric surgery, 'Fluid management' is more critical because:
qh: बाल रोग सर्जरी में 'तरल प्रबंधन' अधिक महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि:
o: Children have low tolerance for fluid imbalance | बच्चों में तरल असंतुलन सहने की क्षमता कम होती है
e: Small changes in fluid volume can cause overload or dehydration in infants quickly. / बच्चों के शरीर में तरल की थोड़ी सी भी कमी या अधिकता जानलेवा हो सकती है।

qe: What is the 'Ethical duty' regarding a patient's 'Informed Consent'?
qh: मरीज की 'सूचित सहमति' (Informed Consent) के संबंध में 'नैतिक कर्तव्य' क्या है?
o: Ensuring the patient understands the procedure before signing | यह सुनिश्चित करना कि मरीज प्रक्रिया समझ गया है
e: Consent must be voluntary and informed, protecting both the patient and the medical team. / बिना पूरी जानकारी और सहमति के सर्जरी करना गैर-कानूनी और अनैतिक है।

qe: How should 'Laryngoscope blades' be cleaned after use?
qh: उपयोग के बाद 'लैरींगोस्कोप ब्लेड' को कैसे साफ किया जाना चाहिए?
o: Washed and High-level Disinfection/Sterilization | धुलाई और उच्च-स्तरीय कीटाणुशोधन
e: Blades must be thoroughly cleaned and disinfected as they contact mucous membranes. Reusable blades are first washed free of blood and secretions and then disinfected or sterilised following the hospital's infection-control policy, because a dirty blade can carry infection into the airway.

qe: What is the 'Self-inflating bag' used for manual ventilation called?
qh: मैनुअल वेंटिलेशन के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले 'सेल्फ-इन्फ्लेटिंग बैग' को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: AMBU (Artificial Manual Breathing Unit) is essential for emergency ventilation. The bag is squeezed by hand to push oxygen into the lungs, so it works even where a ventilator or piped oxygen supply is not available.

qe: Which monitor is used to measure 'End-Tidal Carbon Dioxide' (EtCO2)?
qh: 'एंड-टाइडल कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड' (EtCO2) मापने के लिए किस मॉनिटर का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Capnography confirms correct ET tube placement and adequate ventilation. A sudden fall or loss of the CO2 waveform tells the team that the tube has slipped into the food pipe or that the heart has stopped, which makes it an early warning monitor.

qe: The 'Magill's Forceps' is used for:
qh: 'मैगिल फोर्सप्स' (Magill's Forceps) का उपयोग किया जाता है:
o: Guiding the ET tube during intubation | इंट्यूबेशन के दौरान ट्यूब को निर्देशित करना
e: Magill's forceps help in nasal intubation or removing foreign bodies from the airway. The blades are curved to follow the natural path of the nose, so they help in nasal intubation and in picking out foreign bodies or throat packs.

qe: What is the 'Full form' of C.P.R.?
qh: C.P.R. का 'फुल फॉर्म' क्या है?
e: CPR is an emergency procedure combining chest compressions and ventilation. Cardio-pulmonary resuscitation joins chest compressions with rescue breaths to keep blood and oxygen moving till the heart starts again.

qe: A 'Defibrillator' is used to treat which condition?
qh: 'डिफाइब्रिलेटर' का उपयोग किस स्थिति के इलाज के लिए किया जाता है?
e: It delivers an electric shock to restore normal heart rhythm during cardiac arrest. Ventricular fibrillation and pulseless ventricular tachycardia are the shockable rhythms in which this electric shock can bring back the normal rhythm.

qe: Which part of the O.T. table allows the patient's head to be tilted down?
qh: ओ.टी. टेबल का कौन सा हिस्सा मरीज के सिर को नीचे झुकाने की अनुमति देता है?
e: The Trendelenburg position is used for abdominal surgeries and shock management. In this position the head lies lower than the feet, which helps in shock management and in operations on the lower abdomen and pelvis.

qe: How are 'Rubber goods' (like rebreathing bags) sterilized?
qh: 'रबर के सामान' (जैसे रीब्रीदिंग बैग) को कैसे स्टरलाइज किया जाता है?
o: Chemical disinfection or ETO sterilization | रासायनिक या ईटीओ स्टरलाइजेशन
e: Heat-sensitive rubber items require cold sterilization or specific chemicals. Rubber and plastic items such as masks and rebreathing bags are treated with chemicals like glutaraldehyde or with ethylene oxide, because heat would melt or crack them.

qe: The 'Checklist' for anesthesia safety was introduced by:
qh: एनेस्थीसिया सुरक्षा के लिए 'चेकलिस्ट' किसके द्वारा शुरू की गई थी?
e: The WHO Surgical Safety Checklist helps prevent complications and accidents. It is read aloud in three stages, before induction of anaesthesia, before the skin incision is made and before the patient leaves the operation theatre.

qe: What is the primary concern for a technician in the 'Postoperative/Recovery room'?
qh: 'पोस्ट-ऑपरेटिव/रिकवरी रूम' में तकनीशियन के लिए प्राथमिक चिंता क्या है?
o: Continuous monitoring of vitals and airway | वाइटल और वायुमार्ग की निगरानी
e: Immediate postoperative care focuses on recovery from anesthesia and preventing complications.

qe: Which drug is used to reverse the action of 'Opioids' (like Fentanyl) in case of respiratory depression?
qh: श्वसन अवसाद के मामले में 'ओपिओइड' के प्रभाव को उलटने के लिए किस दवा का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Naloxone is a specific antagonist for opioid overdose or respiratory depression. Naloxone acts within minutes and may be repeated, but its effect wears off earlier than that of the opioid, so the patient is watched closely for some hours.

qe: What is the primary sign of 'Accidental Esophageal Intubation'?
qh: 'गलती से भोजन नली में ट्यूब' (Esophageal Intubation) डलने का प्राथमिक लक्षण क्या है?
o: Absence of breath sounds in lungs and gurgling in stomach | पेट में गड़गड़ाहट और फेफड़ों में आवाज न आना
e: If the ET tube enters the esophagus instead of the trachea, carbon dioxide levels (EtCO2) will drop and lungs won't expand.

qe: Which anesthetic agent is preferred for 'Day Care' surgeries due to rapid recovery?
qh: तेजी से रिकवरी के कारण 'डे केयर' सर्जरी के लिए कौन सा एनेस्थेटिक एजेंट पसंद किया जाता है?
e: Sevoflurane has low solubility and provides very fast induction and emergence. Because the patient wakes up quickly and smoothly, the stay in hospital becomes short, and this makes day-care surgery possible.

qe: The 'Laryngeal Mask Airway' (LMA) is placed in which part of the airway?
qh: 'लैरिंजियल मास्क एयरवे' (LMA) को वायुमार्ग के किस भाग में रखा जाता है?
o: Above the vocal cords in the pharynx | वोकल कॉर्ड के ऊपर ग्रसनी (pharynx) में
e: LMA is a supraglottic device used when full intubation is not required. It sits above the opening of the windpipe and does not enter the trachea, yet it keeps the airway open with less stimulation than full intubation.

qe: What is the function of a 'Vaporizer' in an anesthesia machine?
qh: एनेस्थीसिया मशीन में 'वेपोराइज़र' (Vaporizer) का क्या कार्य है?
o: To convert liquid anesthetic into gas | तरल एनेस्थेटिक को गैस में बदलना
e: Vaporizers precisely control the concentration of volatile anesthetic agents. The anaesthetist sets the dial as a percentage, and the vaporizer adds exactly that much vapour to the fresh gas flowing towards the patient.

qe: Which local anesthetic is commonly used for 'Epidural' anesthesia?
qh: 'एपिड्यूरल' एनेस्थीसिया के लिए आमतौर पर किस लोकल एनेस्थेटिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Bupivacaine is long-acting and preferred for epidural blocks for labor or surgery. It acts for several hours, so it is useful in labour pain relief, lower limb surgery and control of pain after operation.

qe: An 'Epidural' space is located:
qh: 'एपिड्यूरल' स्पेस कहाँ स्थित होता है?
o: Outside the dura mater | ड्यूरा मेटर के बाहर
e: Epidural anesthesia involves injecting medicine into the space around the spinal nerves. This space lies outside the dura mater, and the drug spreads to the nerve roots that leave the spinal cord.

qe: Which of these is a 'Depolarizing' muscle relaxant?
qh: इनमें से कौन सा 'डिपोलराइजिंग' मसल रिलैक्सेंट है?
e: Succinylcholine is used for rapid sequence induction due to its quick onset. Because it relaxes the muscles very quickly and for a short time, it is chosen for rapid sequence intubation and for short procedures.

qe: What is the common side effect of 'Spinal Anaesthesia'?
qh: 'स्पाइनल एनेस्थीसिया' का सामान्य दुष्प्रभाव क्या है?
e: Leaking of CSF through the dural puncture site can cause severe headache after spinal anesthesia.

qe: In the O.T., 'Ketamine' is known for causing:
qh: ओ.टी. में 'केटामाइन' किसके लिए जाना जाता है?
e: Ketamine makes the patient appear awake but detached from the environment and pain. The patient may keep the eyes open and move the limbs but feels no pain, and this state is called dissociative anaesthesia.

qe: In case of 'Cardiac Arrest' in the O.T., what is the technician's immediate role?
qh: ओ.टी. में 'कार्डियक अरेस्ट' होने पर तकनीशियन की तत्काल भूमिका क्या है?
o: Assist in CPR and bring the Crash Cart/Defibrillator | सीपीआर और क्रैश कार्ट लाना
e: Technicians must act quickly to provide equipment and help in resuscitation. The technician starts chest compressions at once, calls for help and keeps the defibrillator and emergency drugs ready.

qe: What is the 'Golden Hour' in emergency management?
qh: आपातकालीन प्रबंधन में 'गोल्डन आवर' (Golden Hour) क्या है?
o: The first hour after injury where treatment is most effective | चोट के बाद का पहला घंटा
e: Quick medical intervention during the first hour can significantly improve survival rates.

qe: Which tube is placed into the 'Trachea' to maintain a patent airway?
qh: पेटेंट एयरवे बनाए रखने के लिए 'ट्रेकिया' में कौन सी ट्यूब डाली जाती है?
e: An ET tube is used for mechanical ventilation and airway protection during surgery. The tube is passed through the mouth or nose into the trachea and its cuff is inflated to seal the airway, so that stomach contents cannot enter the lungs.

qe: The 'Soda Lime' in an anesthesia machine is used to:
qh: एनेस्थीसिया मशीन में 'सोडा लाइम' का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
o: Absorb Carbon Dioxide (CO2) | कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड को सोखना
e: Soda lime canisters remove CO2 from the patient's exhaled breath in a closed circuit. The granules absorb the carbon dioxide breathed out by the patient, which lets the same gases be used again in a closed or low-flow circuit.

qe: What should be used to lubricate an ET tube before insertion?
qh: एंडोट्रैकियल ट्यूब डालने से पहले उसे चिकना करने के लिए किसका उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए?
e: Water-soluble lubricants prevent injury to the delicate tissues of the airway. A water-soluble jelly reduces friction while the tube passes the vocal cords, and it does not injure the lining of the airway.

qe: Maintenance of O.T. equipment includes:
qh: ओ.टी. उपकरणों के रखरखाव (Maintenance) में शामिल है:
o: Regular cleaning, sterilization, and calibration | सफाई, स्टरलाइजेशन और कैलिब्रेशन
e: Routine maintenance ensures equipment reliability and patient safety. Daily, weekly and periodical checks are written in a register so that a fault is noticed and set right before the next operation.

qe: What does 'I.C.U.' stand for in the context of postoperative care?
qh: पोस्ट-ऑपरेटिव देखभाल के संदर्भ में 'I.C.U.' का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Intensive Care Unit | इंटेंसिव केयर यूनिट
e: ICU is for patients needing continuous monitoring and life support. Such patients need ventilators, monitors and strong drugs that cannot be managed in a general ward.

qe: Which fluid is commonly used for 'Volume Replacement' after blood loss?
qh: रक्त की कमी के बाद 'वॉल्यूम रिप्लेसमेंट' के लिए आमतौर पर किस तरल का उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Normal Saline or Ringer's Lactate | नॉर्मल सेलाइन या रिंगर लैक्टेट
e: Isotonic fluids like NS or RL are used to maintain blood pressure. Normal saline and Ringer's lactate refill the circulating volume and help to keep the blood pressure and urine output normal.

qe: A 'Pulse Oximeter' measures which of the following?
qh: 'पल्स ऑक्सीमीटर' निम्नलिखित में से किसे मापता है?
o: Oxygen saturation (SpO2) and Pulse rate | ऑक्सीजन सैचुरेशन और पल्स
e: It is a vital non-invasive monitor used throughout the perioperative period. It shines light through the finger or ear lobe and shows the oxygen saturation and pulse rate within seconds, without any prick.

qe: Who is responsible for checking the 'Anesthesia Machine' before the first case of the day?
qh: दिन के पहले केस से पहले 'एनेस्थीसिया मशीन' की जांच के लिए कौन जिम्मेदार है?
o: Anesthesiologist and O.T. Technician | एनेस्थेटिस्ट और ओ.टी. तकनीशियन
e: A pre-use checklist is mandatory to ensure all safety systems are functioning. The anaesthetist checks the machine along with the technician, because a leak in the circuit or an empty cylinder can put the patient in danger.

qe: Which gas is stored in 'Blue' colored cylinders in the Operation Theatre?
qh: ऑपरेशन थिएटर में 'नीले' रंग के सिलेंडर में कौन सी गैस भरी होती है?
e: Nitrous Oxide cylinders are color-coded blue, while Oxygen cylinders have a black body with a white shoulder.

qe: What is the primary function of 'Muscle Relaxants' during surgery?
qh: सर्जरी के दौरान 'मसल रिलैक्सेंट्स' का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
o: To provide skeletal muscle paralysis for easier surgery | मांसपेशियों को शिथिल करना
e: Muscle relaxants like Succinylcholine allow the surgeon to work on relaxed tissues and assist in intubation.

qe: Which drug is commonly used as an 'Intravenous (IV) Induction Agent'?
qh: 'इंट्रावेनस (IV) इंडक्शन एजेंट' के रूप में आमतौर पर किस दवा का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Propofol is a fast-acting IV agent used to induce a state of general anesthesia. It acts within about a minute, so the patient goes to sleep quickly and also wakes up fast with little hangover.

qe: In 'Spinal Anaesthesia', where is the local anaesthetic injected?
qh: 'स्पाइनल एनेस्थीसिया' में लोकल एनेस्थेटिक कहाँ इंजेक्ट किया जाता है?
o: Into the Subarachnoid space (CSF) | सबअराक्नॉइड स्पेस (CSF) में
e: Spinal anesthesia involves placing medication into the cerebrospinal fluid in the lumbar spine.

qe: What is the purpose of 'Pre-anaesthetic medication' like Atropine?
qh: एट्रोपिन जैसी 'प्री-एनेस्थेटिक मेडिकेशन' का उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To reduce secretions and prevent bradycardia | स्राव कम करना और हृदय गति बढ़ाना
e: Atropine is used to dry up secretions and prevent the heart rate from dropping during anesthesia.

qe: Which equipment is used to visualize the vocal cords for 'Intubation'?
qh: 'इंट्यूबेशन' के लिए वोकल कॉर्ड देखने हेतु किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: A laryngoscope is essential for managing the airway and inserting an endotracheal tube. The curved blade lifts the epiglottis and brings the vocal cords into view, so the tube can be guided safely into the windpipe.

qe: What does 'T.U.R.P.' surgery usually require for anesthesia?
qh: 'T.U.R.P.' सर्जरी के लिए आमतौर पर किस एनेस्थीसिया की आवश्यकता होती है?
o: Spinal or Epidural block | स्पाइनल या एपिड्यूरल ब्लॉक
e: Regional anesthesia is often preferred for urogenital surgeries like TURP. Spinal or epidural anaesthesia keeps the patient free of pain while he remains awake, which is safer in elderly patients with an enlarged prostate.

qe: Which of the following is an 'Inhalation Anaesthetic' agent?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'सूंघने वाला एनेस्थेटिक' (Inhalation Anaesthetic) एजेंट है?
o: Halothane or Isoflurane | हेलोथेन या आइसोफ्लुरेन
e: Halothane and Isoflurane are gases/vapors used to maintain general anesthesia. These agents are given mixed with oxygen through a mask or tube, their strength is controlled by the vaporizer and the depth of anaesthesia can be changed quickly.

qe: The 'Brachial Plexus Block' provides anesthesia to which part of the body?
qh: 'ब्रेकियल प्लेक्सस ब्लॉक' शरीर के किस हिस्से को एनेस्थीसिया प्रदान करता है?
e: This nerve block is used for surgeries on the shoulder, arm, and hand. The drug is injected around the network of nerves that supplies the upper limb, so the whole arm becomes numb without general anaesthesia.

qe: What is the concentration of Oxygen in the air we breathe?
qh: जिस हवा में हम सांस लेते हैं उसमें ऑक्सीजन की सांद्रता कितनी होती है?
e: Atmospheric air contains about 21% Oxygen; in O.T., higher concentrations are often delivered.

qe: Which bandage is specifically designed to support the 'Perineum'?
qh: कौन सी बैंडेज विशेष रूप से 'पेरिनम' को सहारा देने के लिए डिज़ाइन की गई है?
e: T-bandages are used to hold dressings securely in the perineal and scrotal areas. The vertical and horizontal strips meet at the back like the letter T, which holds the dressing firmly where an ordinary roller bandage would slip.

qe: What is the 'Scrub Technician's' role regarding surgical instruments?
qh: सर्जिकल उपकरणों के संबंध में 'स्कर्ब तकनीशियन' की क्या भूमिका है?
o: Maintaining sterile field and passing instruments | स्टेराइल क्षेत्र और उपकरणों को सौंपना
e: They must anticipate the surgeon's needs and provide sterile instruments quickly. The scrub nurse is the surgeon's second pair of hands inside the sterile field and must know the steps of the operation in advance.

qe: Which bandaging technique is best for 'Conical' parts like the forearm?
qh: अग्रबाहु (forearm) जैसे 'शंक्वाकार' भागों के लिए कौन सी बैंडेजिंग तकनीक सबसे अच्छी है?
o: Spiral reverse bandage | स्पाइरल रिवर्स बैंडेज
e: Spiral reverse allows the bandage to fit the varying thickness of the limb better. A half twist is taken at every turn so that the bandage lies flat on a part whose thickness changes, such as the forearm or the calf.

qe: In Orthopaedics, a 'Spica' bandage is commonly used for:
qh: ऑर्थोपेडिक्स में, 'स्पाइका' (Spica) बैंडेज का उपयोग आमतौर पर किसके लिए किया जाता है?
o: Shoulder or Hip joints | कंधे या कूल्हे के जोड़
e: It is a figure-of-eight wrap that incorporates a limb and the trunk. It is used for the shoulder, hip or thumb, where the joint has to be kept still along with the adjoining part of the body.

qe: The 'Count' of gauze pieces and instruments must be done:
qh: गॉज पीस और उपकरणों की 'गिनती' कब की जानी चाहिए?
o: Before and after the surgery | सर्जरी से पहले और बाद में
e: Accurate counting prevents retaining foreign objects inside the patient's body. The count is done before the operation begins, before the wound is closed and again after closure, and any mismatch must be reported at once.

qe: Why is 'Vaseline Gauze' often used for skin graft donor sites?
qh: स्किन ग्राफ्ट डोनर साइटों के लिए अक्सर 'वेसलीन गॉज' का उपयोग क्यों किया जाता है?
o: To prevent the dressing from sticking to the wound | ड्रेसिंग को घाव से चिपकने से रोकना
e: Non-adherent dressings are critical for healing skin surfaces. The paraffin layer stops the dressing from sticking to the raw donor area, so the new skin is not pulled off when the dressing is changed.

qe: Which position is used to drain 'Chest fluids' after Thorax surgery?
qh: थोरैक्स सर्जरी के बाद 'छाती के तरल पदार्थ' निकालने के लिए किस स्थिति का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: A semi-sitting (Fowler's) position helps in easier breathing and fluid drainage from the chest.

qe: What is 'Autograft' in plastic surgery?
qh: प्लास्टिक सर्जरी में 'ऑटोग्राफ्ट' (Autograft) क्या है?
o: Skin from the same patient's body | उसी मरीज के शरीर से त्वचा
e: An autograft uses the patient's own tissue, which has the best chance of survival. Because the skin is taken from the patient's own body, there is no risk of rejection, and it is the first choice for covering burn wounds.

qe: The term 'Evisceration' in wound complications refers to:
qh: घाव की जटिलताओं में 'एविसरेशन' (Evisceration) का तात्पर्य है:
o: Protrusion of internal organs through an opened wound | अंगों का घाव से बाहर निकलना
e: It is a surgical emergency where abdominal organs come out of the incision site. It is usually seen when an abdominal wound gives way after operation, and the patient must be taken to the theatre at once with the exposed part kept moist and covered.

qe: Who is responsible for the 'Fumigation' of the O.T. complex?
qh: ओ.टी. कॉम्प्लेक्स के 'धूमीकरण' (Fumigation) के लिए कौन जिम्मेदार है?
o: O.T. cleaning and fumigation incharge | ओ.टी. सफाई और धूमीकरण प्रभारी
e: Strict coordination is needed to maintain a sterile environment. The O.T. assistant, with the sister in charge, carries out the sealing, the choice of the fumigating agent and the hours of closure follow the hospital's infection-control policy.

qe: What is the primary goal of 'Reconstructive Surgery' in plastic surgery?
qh: प्लास्टिक सर्जरी में 'रिकंस्ट्रक्टिव सर्जरी' का प्राथमिक लक्ष्य क्या है?
o: To restore function and normal appearance | कार्यक्षमता और सामान्य बनावट की बहाली
e: Reconstructive surgery focuses on fixing physical defects caused by birth, trauma, or disease.

qe: A 'Split-thickness skin graft' involves which layers of the skin?
qh: 'स्प्लिट-थिकनेस स्किन ग्राफ्ट' में त्वचा की कौन सी परतें शामिल होती हैं?
o: Epidermis and part of the dermis | एपिडर्मिस और डर्मिस का हिस्सा
e: It is used in plastic surgery to cover large areas of skin loss using a thin layer of healthy skin.

qe: Which type of 'Surgical Drain' uses a vacuum system to pull fluid?
qh: किस प्रकार का 'सर्जिकल ड्रेन' तरल खींचने के लिए वैक्यूम सिस्टम का उपयोग करता है?
o: Redivac or Suction drain | रेडवैक या सक्शन ड्रेन
e: Closed suction drains like Redivac are used to remove blood or fluid from deep surgical sites.

qe: The term 'Skin Flap' differs from a 'Graft' because a flap:
qh: 'स्किन फ्लैप' एक 'ग्राफ्ट' से अलग है क्योंकि फ्लैप में:
o: Has its own blood supply | अपनी रक्त आपूर्ति होती है
e: A flap is moved with its blood supply intact, whereas a graft is completely detached. Since the flap carries its own blood vessels, it survives on tissues where a graft would fail, such as over bare bone, tendon or a joint.

qe: In plastic surgery, 'Cleft Lip' repair is an example of which specialty?
qh: प्लास्टिक सर्जरी में, 'कटे हुए होंठ' (Cleft Lip) की मरम्मत किसका उदाहरण है?
o: Pediatric & Reconstructive surgery | बाल रोग और पुनर्रचनात्मक सर्जरी
e: Correcting congenital defects like cleft lip is a major part of pediatric plastic surgery.

qe: What is the primary function of a 'Penrose Drain'?
qh: 'पेनरोस ड्रेन' (Penrose Drain) का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
o: Passive drainage by gravity | गुरुत्वाकर्षण द्वारा निष्क्रिय जल निकासी
e: It is an open, soft latex tube that allows fluid to drain out of a wound onto a dressing. The open end is kept outside and covered with a sterile pad, and the drain is shortened or removed as the discharge decreases.

qe: Which instrument is used to take a thin slice of skin for grafting?
qh: ग्राफ्टिंग के लिए त्वचा की एक पतली स्लाइस लेने के लिए किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: A dermatome is a specialized surgical tool used to produce thin slices of skin for grafting.

qe: What is 'Secondary Intention' healing common in?
qh: 'सेकेंडरी इंटेंशन' हीलिंग किसमें आम है?
o: Large, infected, or gaping wounds | बड़े या संक्रमित घाव
e: These wounds are left open to heal from the bottom up by granulation tissue formation. This is seen in infected or gaping wounds, burns and pressure sores, where the defect fills up with granulation tissue and leaves a broader scar.

qe: The removal of necrotic (dead) tissue from a wound is called:
qh: घाव से नेक्रोटिक (मृत) ऊतक को हटाना कहलाता है:
e: Debridement is essential to clean the wound and promote healthy healing. Removing the dead tissue lowers the bacterial load and allows fresh granulation tissue and new skin to grow.

qe: A 'Pressure Ulcer' (Decubitus ulcer) is most likely to occur in:
qh: 'प्रेशर अल्सर' (डेक्यूबिटस अल्सर) होने की सबसे अधिक संभावना किसमें होती है?
o: Bed-ridden or unconscious patients | बिस्तर पर पड़े या बेहोश मरीज
e: Prolonged immobilization on the operation table or bed can cause these ulcers. The ulcer starts on bony points such as the heel, the hip or the sacrum, and a regular change of position is the best way to prevent it.

qe: Which bandage is used to provide support to a fractured 'Clavicle' (Collar bone)?
qh: टूटी हुई 'क्लैविकिल' (कॉलर बोन) को सहारा देने के लिए किस बैंडेज का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: The figure-of-eight wrap helps in keeping the shoulders pulled back for bone alignment. The two loops pass under the armpits and cross behind the back, which pulls the shoulders backwards and keeps the broken ends of the collar bone in line.

qe: What is the primary function of a 'Surgical Drain' after a major surgery?
qh: एक प्रमुख सर्जरी के बाद 'सर्जिकल ड्रेन' का प्राथमिक कार्य क्या है?
o: To prevent fluid/blood accumulation | तरल/रक्त जमा होने से रोकना
e: Drains remove excess fluid that could cause infection or pressure. By letting the collected blood or pus come out, the drain reduces pain, infection and the risk of an abscess.

qe: Which type of bandaging is used for 'Scalp' wounds?
qh: 'स्कैल्प' (सिर) के घावों के लिए किस प्रकार की बैंडेजिंग का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Capeline is a specialized wrap that covers the entire head securely. It is used after scalp wounds or cranial surgery, because a simple roller bandage cannot hold on to the rounded head.

qe: A 'Sling' is used to immobilize and support which part of the body?
qh: 'स्लिंग' (Sling) का उपयोग शरीर के किस भाग को स्थिर और सहारा देने के लिए किया जाता है?
e: A triangular sling supports the weight of an injured arm or shoulder. The triangular bandage is tied round the neck and supports the arm, keeping the elbow bent and the shoulder at rest.

qe: What is the purpose of 'Post-operative dressing' on the lips and nose?
qh: होठों और नाक पर 'पोस्ट-ऑपरेटिव ड्रेसिंग' का उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To protect the surgical site and absorb secretions | सर्जिकल साइट की सुरक्षा
e: Careful dressing prevents infection and supports delicate repair sites. These are delicate areas where the dressing also keeps the wound edges together and protects them from saliva and dust.

qe: The term 'Debridement' in wound care refers to:
qh: घाव की देखभाल में 'डिब्राइडमेंट' (Debridement) का तात्पर्य है:
o: Removal of infected or dead tissue | संक्रमित या मृत ऊतक को हटाना
e: Cleaning out dead tissue is essential for proper wound healing. It may be surgical, chemical or mechanical, and it may have to be repeated till the wound looks clean and red.

qe: Which bandage is most suitable for 'Finger' or 'Toe' injuries?
qh: 'उंगली' या 'पैर के अंगूठे' की चोटों के लिए कौन सी बैंडेज सबसे उपयुक्त है?
o: Spiral or Roller bandage | रोलर बैंडेज
e: Small roller bandages are used to wrap individual digits securely. A narrow roller bandage is rolled from the tip towards the base in overlapping turns, which covers the digit without causing pressure.

qe: What is 'Primary Intention' healing?
qh: 'प्राइमरी इंटेंशन' हीलिंग क्या है?
o: Healing when edges are joined by sutures | टांके द्वारा किनारों को जोड़कर हीलिंग
e: Sutured wounds heal quickly with minimal scarring. It applies to clean, surgically sutured wounds where the edges are held together and there is no gap or infection.

qe: Why is 'Plaster of Paris' (POP) slab used in Orthopaedic surgery?
qh: ऑर्थोपेडिक सर्जरी में 'प्लास्टर ऑफ पेरिस' (POP) स्लैब का उपयोग क्यों किया जाता है?
o: To provide rigid immobilization of fractures | फ्रैक्चर को स्थिर करना
e: Slabs and casts keep the broken bones in the correct position to heal. It is moulded while still wet and hardens as it dries, giving support and rest to the injured part.

qe: A 'Pressure dressing' is primarily used to:
qh: 'प्रेशर ड्रेसिंग' का मुख्य रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है:
o: Control bleeding (Hemorrhage) | रक्तस्राव को नियंत्रित करना
e: Applying pressure helps in stopping active bleeding at the site. It is used in wounds that ooze or bleed, as in a cut scalp or after a biopsy, to control the bleeding without stitching.

qe: Which incision is typically used for a 'Cesarean Section' (Lower segment) in Urogenital surgery?
qh: मूत्रजननांगी सर्जरी में 'सिजेरियन सेक्शन' के लिए आमतौर पर कौन सा चीरा लगाया जाता है?
e: A Pfannenstiel incision is a transverse lower abdominal incision used for pelvic surgeries.

qe: In ENT surgery, 'Tonsillectomy' refers to the removal of:
qh: ENT सर्जरी में 'टॉन्सिलेक्टोमी' (Tonsillectomy) का तात्पर्य किसे निकालने से है?
e: Tonsillectomy is a common ENT surgical procedure to remove inflamed tonsils. It is done when the tonsils become repeatedly infected or so large that they block breathing and swallowing.

qe: Which surgical incision is used to access the 'Brain' in Neurological diseases?
qh: न्यूरोलॉजिकल रोगों में 'मस्तिष्क' तक पहुँचने के लिए किस सर्जिकल चीरे का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Craniotomy involves making a bone flap in the skull to access the brain. The bone flap is put back and fixed at the end of the operation, and the approach may be frontal, temporal or occipital depending on the site of the disease.

qe: The 'Lawn-tennis' or 'Gridiron' incision is another name for:
qh: 'लॉन-टेनिस' या 'ग्रिडिरॉन' चीरा किसका दूसरा नाम है?
e: This is a muscle-splitting incision used primarily for an appendectomy. The muscles are split along their fibres instead of being cut across, so the healing is quicker and the scar is strong.

qe: In 'Hepatobiliary surgery', which organ is primarily involved?
qh: 'हेपेटोबिलरी सर्जरी' में मुख्य रूप से कौन सा अंग शामिल होता है?
o: Liver and Gallbladder | लिवर और पित्ताशय
e: It involves surgeries of the liver, bile ducts, and gallbladder. The common operations are removal of the gallbladder, removal of stones from the bile duct and repair of liver injuries.

qe: A 'Z-plasty' is a common technique used in which specialty?
qh: 'Z-प्लास्टी' किस विशेषता में उपयोग की जाने वाली एक सामान्य तकनीक है?
e: Z-plasty is used to improve the functional and cosmetic appearance of scars. Two triangular flaps are interchanged so that the scar line is lengthened and made to lie along the natural creases of the skin.

qe: Which incision is used to access the 'Thorax' for lung surgery?
qh: फेफड़ों की सर्जरी के लिए 'थोरैक्स' तक पहुँचने हेतु किस चीरे का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: A midline incision through the sternum is used for heart and some lung procedures. It gives a wide view of both lungs and the heart, but it takes longer to heal than the side incisions used for a single lung.

qe: What is 'Tracheostomy' in ENT surgery?
qh: ENT सर्जरी में 'ट्रेकियोस्टोमी' (Tracheostomy) क्या है?
o: Creating an opening in the Windpipe | श्वास नली में छेद करना
e: It is an incision in the windpipe (trachea) to provide an alternative airway. It is used when the upper airway is blocked or when the patient needs a ventilator for a long time.

qe: Which surgery involves the 'Spine region' for correcting disc problems?
qh: डिस्क की समस्याओं को ठीक करने के लिए 'रीढ़ की हड्डी' की कौन सी सर्जरी शामिल है?
e: Laminectomy is a spinal surgery that removes part of the vertebra. Removing part of the vertebral arch takes pressure off the spinal cord and nerves, and it is often done for a slipped disc.

qe: Pediatric surgery focuses on patients of which age group?
qh: पीडियाट्रिक सर्जरी किस आयु वर्ग के रोगियों पर केंद्रित है?
o: Infants and Children | शिशु और बच्चे
e: It addresses surgical needs from newborns to adolescents. These patients need smaller instruments, special doses of drugs and careful attention to body temperature.

qe: What is the tube used to drain fluids from a wound after surgery called?
qh: ऑपरेशन के बाद घाव से तरल पदार्थ (स्राव) निकालने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाली नली क्या कहलाती है?
e: Drains are used to prevent the accumulation of fluid (blood/pus) at the surgical site. / ड्रेन घाव के पास तरल जमा होने से रोकते हैं ताकि संक्रमण न हो।

qe: Which type of bandage is best for a scalp injury?
qh: स्कैल्प (सिर) की चोट के लिए किस प्रकार की बैंडेज (पट्टी) सबसे उपयुक्त है?
e: Capeline bandage is a specialized head bandage used to hold dressings on the scalp. / सिर की ड्रेसिंग को थामे रखने के लिए कैपलाइन पट्टी का उपयोग होता है।

qe: Which technique is used for finger or toe bandaging?
qh: अंगुलियों या पैरों के अंगूठे की बैंडेजिंग के लिए कौन सी तकनीक अपनाई जाती है?
o: स्पाइरल या फिगर ऑफ एइट | स्पाइरल (Spiral) बैंडेज
e: Spiral or figure-of-eight techniques are used for uniform pressure on cylindrical body parts like fingers. / अंगुलियों जैसे अंगों के लिए स्पाइरल तकनीक सबसे अच्छी है।

qe: Which bandage is used to stabilize shoulder or hip joints?
qh: कंधे या कूल्हे के जोड़ को स्थिर करने के लिए किस प्रकार की बैंडेज का उपयोग होता है?
e: A spica bandage is a figure-of-eight wrap used for joints where the limb meets the trunk. / जहाँ अंग धड़ से जुड़ते हैं, वहां स्पाइका पट्टी का उपयोग होता है।

qe: What does a 'Sterile Dressing' mean?
qh: एक 'स्टरिल ड्रेसिंग' (Sterile Dressing) का मतलब क्या है?
o: सूक्ष्मजीवों से पूरी तरह मुक्त पट्टी | कीटाणुमुक्त पट्टी
e: Sterile dressings are processed to be free from all microorganisms to prevent surgical infection. / स्टरिल का अर्थ है ऐसी पट्टी जो पूरी तरह कीटाणुमुक्त हो।

qe: Which bandage is used for support after scrotal surgery?
qh: अंडकोश (Scrotum) की सर्जरी के बाद कौन सी बैंडेज सहारा देने के लिए इस्तेमाल होती है?
e: A T-bandage is designed specifically to hold dressings in the perineal region or scrotum. / पेरिनियल क्षेत्र की ड्रेसिंग के लिए 'T' आकार की पट्टी काम आती है।

qe: What is the main purpose of a 'Cast' in orthopedic surgery?
qh: ऑर्थोपेडिक सर्जरी में इस्तेमाल होने वाले 'कास्ट' (Cast) का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: टूटी हड्डी को पूरी तरह स्थिर करना | हड्डी का स्थिरीकरण
e: Casts (like Plaster of Paris) immobilize fractured bones to allow proper healing. / कास्ट (प्लास्टर) हड्डी को हिलने से रोकता है ताकि वह जुड़ सके।

qe: What is the process of wound healing when edges do not meet?
qh: जब घाव के किनारे आपस में नहीं जुड़ते, तो उसे भरने की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Wounds that cannot be sutured heal by granulation and contraction (secondary intention). / खुले घाव जो नीचे से ऊपर की ओर भरते हैं, उन्हें सेकेंडरी इंटेंशन कहते हैं।

qe: What is used to support the arm in case of a fracture?
qh: हाथ के फ्रैक्चर के मामले में हाथ को सहारा देने के लिए किसका उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: A triangular bandage or sling supports the weight of the injured arm against the chest. / स्लिंग टूटे हुए हाथ के वजन को छाती के सहारे थामे रखता है।

qe: Which incision is commonly used for Appendectomy?
qh: अपेंडिसेक्टोमी (Appendectomy) के लिए आमतौर पर पेट के दाहिने निचले हिस्से में कौन सा चीरा लगाया जाता है?
e: McBurney's incision is a gridiron incision used specifically to access the appendix. / मैकबर्नी चीरा अपेंडिक्स तक पहुँचने के लिए सबसे सटीक स्थान है।

qe: What is the incision below the ribs for gallbladder surgery called?
qh: पित्ताशय (Gallbladder) की सर्जरी के लिए पसलियों के नीचे लगाया जाने वाला चीरा क्या कहलाता है?
o: कोचर का सबकोस्टल चीरा | कोचर का सबकोस्टल चीरा
e: Kocher's subcostal incision provides excellent exposure for open cholecystectomy. / यह चीरा पित्ताशय की सर्जरी के लिए पसलियों के समानांतर लगाया जाता है।

qe: What is the horizontal incision on the neck for thyroid surgery called?
qh: थायराइड (Thyroid) सर्जरी के दौरान गर्दन पर लगाया जाने वाला क्षैतिज चीरा क्या कहलाता है?
e: A transverse collar incision is made in the skin crease of the neck for aesthetic and surgical access. / गर्दन की त्वचा की सिलवटों में लगाया जाने वाला यह चीरा कॉलर की तरह दिखता है।

qe: Myringotomy in ENT surgery is related to which organ?
qh: ENT सर्जरी में 'मायरिंगोटॉमी' (Myringotomy) का संबंध किस अंग से है?
e: Myringotomy is a surgical procedure to create a tiny hole in the eardrum to relieve pressure or drain fluid. / कान के पर्दे में छेद करने की प्रक्रिया को मायरिंगोटॉमी कहते हैं।

qe: What is the surgery used to fix bone fractures called?
qh: हड्डियों के फ्रैक्चर को ठीक करने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाली सर्जरी क्या कहलाती है?
e: Orthopaedic surgery involves internal or external fixation of bones using plates, screws, or rods. / हड्डियों और जोड़ों से संबंधित सर्जरी ऑर्थोपेडिक के अंतर्गत आती है। Dressings protect the wound from trauma/infection and absorb inflammatory exudates. Pediatric surgery focuses on the surgical care of infants, children, and adolescents. Skin grafting involves taking healthy skin from one part of the body to cover a wound or burn.

qe: What is the procedure to remove the prostate in urogenital surgery called?
qh: मूत्रजननांगी (Urogenital) सर्जरी में 'प्रोस्टेट' को हटाने की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Prostatectomy is the surgical removal of all or part of the prostate gland. / प्रोस्टेट ग्रंथि को निकालने की सर्जरी को प्रोस्टेटेक्टोमी कहते हैं।

qe: What is the name of the surgery to remove the kidney?
qh: किडनी (वृक्क) को निकालने वाली सर्जरी का क्या नाम है?
e: Nephrectomy is the surgical removal of a kidney, either partially or completely. / किडनी को शरीर से अलग करने की प्रक्रिया नेफरेक्टोमी कहलाती है।

qe: What is the incision made to open the chest (thorax) called?
qh: छाती (Thorax) को खोलने के लिए लगाया जाने वाला चीरा क्या कहलाता है?
e: Thoracotomy is an incision into the pleural space of the chest to access lungs or heart. / फेफड़ों या हृदय तक पहुँचने के लिए छाती पर लगाया गया चीरा थोरैकोटॉमी है।

qe: What is the characteristic symptom of 'Hepatitis-B' during physical examination?
qh: शारीरिक परीक्षण के दौरान 'हेपेटाइटिस-बी' का विशिष्ट लक्षण क्या है?
o: Yellowish eyes and skin (Jaundice) | आँखों और त्वचा का पीलापन
e: Jaundice indicates liver inflammation common in Hepatitis. Dark urine, pale stools and loss of appetite are also common, and the patient is highly infectious during this stage.

qe: Which system does 'Neurological disease' primarily affect?
qh: 'न्यूरोलॉजिकल रोग' मुख्य रूप से किस तंत्र को प्रभावित करता है?
o: Nervous system (Brain and Spine) | तंत्रिका तंत्र
e: It involves disorders of the brain, spinal cord, and nerves. Such patients may have fits, weakness or loss of consciousness, so the technician must protect the airway during transport and surgery.

qe: In a diabetic patient, what does a 'Glucometer' measure?
qh: मधुमेह के रोगी में 'ग्लूकोमीटर' क्या मापता है?
o: Blood Glucose levels | ब्लड ग्लूकोज का स्तर
e: Monitoring sugar is vital for diabetic patients in the O.T. A small drop of blood from the fingertip is put on the strip, and the reading guides the dose of insulin or glucose given around the operation.

qe: What is 'Oedema' in a patient with heart or renal disease?
qh: हृदय या गुर्दे की बीमारी वाले रोगी में 'एडिमा' (Oedema) क्या है?
o: Swelling due to fluid retention | तरल के कारण सूजन
e: It is a sign of organ failure and fluid overload. When the heart or the kidney cannot remove the extra fluid, it collects in the tissues of the legs, the face or the lungs.

qe: The term 'Chronic' in COPD means:
qh: COPD में 'क्रोनिक' (Chronic) शब्द का अर्थ है:
o: Long-lasting and persistent | लंबे समय तक रहने वाला
e: COPD is a progressive lung condition that lasts for a long duration. Chronic means the condition lasts for months or years and cannot be cured, though it can be controlled with medicines and breathing exercises.

qe: Which precautions are taken after an HIV positive patient's surgery?
qh: एचआईवी पॉजिटिव मरीज की सर्जरी के बाद क्या सावधानियां बरती जाती हैं?
o: Strict disinfection and fumigation | सख्त कीटाणुशोधन और धूमीकरण
e: Infection control is critical to prevent cross-contamination. The team uses double gloves, goggles and safe disposal of sharps, and the theatre is disinfected after the procedure.

qe: A patient with 'Typhoid Fever' may have which symptom?
qh: 'टाइफाइड बुखार' वाले रोगी में कौन सा लक्षण हो सकता है?
o: Sustained high fever | लगातार तेज बुखार
e: Typhoid is a systemic infection with high-grade fever. The fever rises in a stepwise manner and is often accompanied by a slow pulse, a coated tongue and a constipated abdomen.

qe: Why is 'C.P.R.' knowledge important for technicians in the O.T.?
qh: ओ.टी. में तकनीशियनों के लिए 'C.P.R.' का ज्ञान क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है?
o: To manage sudden cardiac arrest | अचानक कार्डियक अरेस्ट को संभालना
e: Technicians must assist the anesthesiologist during life-saving procedures. The first few minutes decide the outcome, so the technician must start compressions, call for help and bring the emergency trolley.

qe: What is 'Cyanosis' a sign of?
qh: 'साइनोसिस' किसका संकेत है?
o: Inadequate oxygen in blood | रक्त में ऑक्सीजन की कमी
e: It is a bluish discoloration of the skin, indicating hypoxia. It appears first on the lips, nails and tongue, and it warns that the blood is not carrying enough oxygen.

qe: Monitoring 'Blood Pressure' in the O.T. helps in detecting:
qh: ओ.टी. में 'ब्लड प्रेशर' की निगरानी किसका पता लगाने में मदद करती है?
o: Shock or internal hemorrhage | शॉक या आंतरिक रक्तस्राव
e: A drop in BP is a critical sign of hemorrhage during surgery. A sudden fall can mean hidden bleeding or a reaction to the drug, while a rise may point to pain or a light plane of anaesthesia.

qe: Which is a common symptom of 'Intestinal Tuberculosis'?
qh: 'आंतों की टीबी' (Intestinal TB) का एक सामान्य लक्षण क्या है?
o: Abdominal pain and altered bowel habits | पेट दर्द और मल त्याग की आदतों में बदलाव
e: Abdominal TB often presents with pain, distension, and weight loss. The patient may also complain of fever, loose motions and loss of weight, and the disease often mimics other abdominal conditions.

qe: What is 'Pott's disease' in the context of Tuberculosis?
qh: टीबी के संदर्भ में 'पोट्स रोग' (Pott's disease) क्या है?
o: TB of the Spine (Bone) | रीढ़ की हड्डी की टीबी
e: Tuberculosis of the bone specifically affecting the spine is known as Pott's disease. The infection damages the vertebral bodies, causing back pain and a bent spine, and it may press on the spinal cord.

qe: In 'Valvular Heart Disease', which valve is most commonly affected leading to heart failure?
qh: 'वाल्वुलर हार्ट डिजीज' में कौन सा वाल्व सबसे अधिक प्रभावित होता है जिससे हार्ट फेल्योर होता है?
e: Mitral and Aortic valves are frequently involved in valvular diseases. The valves may become narrow or leaky, which puts extra load on the heart and needs antibiotic cover during operation.

qe: What is the primary concern for an O.T. technician during surgery on a patient with 'Chronic Renal Failure'?
qh: 'क्रोनिक रीनल फेल्योर' के रोगी की सर्जरी के दौरान ओ.टी. तकनीशियन की प्राथमिक चिंता क्या है?
o: Fluid and electrolyte balance | तरल और इलेक्ट्रोलाइट संतुलन
e: Kidney failure affects the body's ability to manage fluids and potassium levels. The anaesthetist avoids drugs that are cleared by the kidney and watches the fluid balance and potassium level closely.

qe: Neurological diseases of the 'Spine region' may lead to which complications in O.T.?
qh: 'रीढ़ की हड्डी' के न्यूरोलॉजिकल रोगों से ओ.टी. में क्या जटिलताएं हो सकती हैं?
o: Loss of motor function or paralysis | मोटर फंक्शन की हानि या पक्षाघात
e: Spinal diseases can cause sensory and motor deficits, requiring careful positioning. Such patients may need careful handling during transfer and positioning so that the weak limbs and spine are not injured.

qe: Why is 'Physical Examination' of pallor (paleness) done before surgery?
qh: सर्जरी से पहले 'पेलर' (पीलापन) की शारीरिक जांच क्यों की जाती है?
o: To screen for Anemia | एनीमिया की स्क्रीनिंग के लिए
e: Pallor suggests low hemoglobin, which can increase surgical risk. The lower eyelid, palm, nail bed and tongue are examined, since paleness of these sites appears early, even before the haemoglobin falls very low.

qe: In a patient with 'Heart Failure', the O.T. assistant should observe for:
qh: 'हार्ट फेल्योर' के रोगी में ओ.टी. सहायक को क्या देखना चाहिए?
o: Difficulty in breathing (Dyspnea) | सांस लेने में कठिनाई
e: Dyspnea is a hallmark sign of a failing heart. The patient may also have cough, breathlessness on lying down and swelling of the feet, and the head of the bed is often kept raised.

qe: What is the O.T. precaution for a patient with 'HIV/AIDS'?
qh: 'HIV/AIDS' वाले रोगी के लिए ओ.टी. में क्या सावधानी है?
o: Double gloving and sharp safety | डबल ग्लव्स और शार्प सुरक्षा
e: Universal precautions are strictly followed to prevent needle-stick injuries. Needles are not recapped by hand and are put in a puncture-proof box, and every spill is cleaned with hypochlorite solution.

qe: Which clinical sign is a priority in monitoring 'Hypertension'?
qh: 'हाइपरटेंशन' की निगरानी में कौन सा नैदानिक संकेत प्राथमिकता है?
e: High BP must be managed to prevent intraoperative stroke or heart issues. The blood pressure is noted before, during and after the operation, and an emergency drug is kept ready to control a sudden rise.

qe: The knowledge of 'Various medical diseases' is important for O.T. technicians to:
qh: ओ.टी. तकनीशियनों के लिए 'विभिन्न चिकित्सा रोगों' का ज्ञान महत्वपूर्ण है:
o: Provide safe patient care and handle emergencies | सुरक्षित देखभाल और आपातकाल संभालना
e: Technical knowledge ensures better assistance during surgery. For example, a diabetic or a cardiac patient needs different care during surgery, and ignoring this can lead to complications.

qe: Which virus causes 'HIV/AIDS'?
qh: 'HIV/AIDS' का कारण कौन सा वायरस है?
o: Human Immunodeficiency Virus | ह्यूमन इम्यूनोडिफीशिएंसी वायरस
e: HIV destroys the immune system, making the patient susceptible to infections. The virus spreads through blood, sexual contact and from mother to child, and it is not spread by touching or sharing food.

qe: The primary symptom of 'Typhoid Fever' is:
qh: 'टाइफाइड बुखार' का प्राथमिक लक्षण है:
o: Step-ladder pattern fever | स्टेप-लैडर पैटर्न बुखार
e: Typhoid fever typically presents with a high-grade fever that increases gradually. The fever may last two to four weeks if untreated, and the patient looks very ill with a dull, tired face.

qe: How is 'Hepatitis-B' primarily transmitted in a hospital setting?
qh: अस्पताल की सेटिंग में 'हेपेटाइटिस-बी' मुख्य रूप से कैसे फैलता है?
o: Accidental needle-stick injuries | सुई चुभने वाली चोट
e: Contaminated blood and needles are the most common routes of transmission. A needle-stick injury or a splash of infected blood on broken skin is enough to pass the infection, so vaccination and safe handling are essential.

qe: The clinical sign 'Cyanosis' indicates:
qh: नैदानिक संकेत 'साइनोसिस' (Cyanosis) क्या दर्शाता है?
o: Severe lack of oxygen (Hypoxia) | ऑक्सीजन की भारी कमी
e: Cyanosis is a bluish discoloration of skin and mucus membranes due to low oxygen. Early cyanosis is seen in the nail beds and lips, and it tells the team that the oxygen supply must be increased at once.

qe: What does 'Oedema' in the feet suggest in a cardiac patient?
qh: कार्डियक रोगी में पैरों में 'एडिमा' (सूजन) क्या संकेत देता है?
o: Fluid retention due to heart failure | हार्ट फेल्योर के कारण तरल जमा होना
e: Dependent oedema is a common sign of right-sided heart failure. The swelling is soft and pits on pressure, and it usually appears in the evening and reduces after a night's rest.

qe: Why is 'Hepatitis-B' vaccination critical for O.T. Technicians?
qh: ओ.टी. तकनीशियनों के लिए 'हेपेटाइटिस-बी' टीकाकरण क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है?
o: To provide prophylaxis against occupational exposure | व्यावसायिक जोखिम से बचाव
e: Vaccination is the best defense against Hepatitis-B infection in the O.T. Three doses given at 0, 1 and 6 months give long-lasting protection, and the antibody level can be checked after the course.

qe: Which system is weakened in 'HIV/AIDS'?
qh: 'HIV/AIDS' में कौन सा तंत्र कमजोर हो जाता है?
e: HIV targets CD4 cells, which are crucial for the body's defense. As the CD4 count falls, the patient becomes prone to tuberculosis, fungal and other infections that a healthy body would resist.

qe: In a diabetic patient, 'Hypoglycemia' is indicated by:
qh: एक मधुमेह रोगी में, 'हाइपोग्लाइसीमिया' किसके द्वारा सूचित किया जाता है?
o: Sweating and confusion | पसीना और भ्रम
e: Low blood sugar levels can lead to rapid pulse, sweating, and altered mental state. The patient may feel hungry, weak, sweaty or confused, and a glucose drink or injection must be given immediately.

qe: What clinical symptom is 'Pallor'?
qh: 'पेलर' (Pallor) कौन सा नैदानिक लक्षण है?
o: Pale appearance (sign of Anemia) | पीलापन (एनीमिया का संकेत)
e: Pallor is the paleness of skin and mucous membranes, often seen in anemia. Pallor is best checked in the conjunctiva, the palm and the nail bed, and it is a common sign of anaemia and blood loss.

qe: Universal Precautions are mainly followed to prevent:
qh: मुख्य रूप से किसके बचाव के लिए 'यूनिवर्सल प्रिकॉशन' का पालन किया जाता है?
o: Cross-infection from HIV and Hepatitis | एचआईवी और हेपेटाइटिस का संक्रमण
e: Handling every patient sample as potentially infectious prevents the spread of blood-borne diseases.

qe: What is the primary indicator of 'Hypertension' during physical examination?
qh: शारीरिक परीक्षण के दौरान 'हाइपरटेंशन' का प्राथमिक संकेतक क्या है?
o: Persistent high Blood Pressure | लगातार उच्च रक्तचाप
e: Hypertension is defined as a systolic BP >140 mmHg or diastolic BP >90 mmHg. The reading must be taken with the patient at rest and the cuff at the level of the heart before it is labelled high.

qe: A patient with 'Renal Failure' often requires which procedure before surgery to filter blood?
qh: रक्त को छानने के लिए सर्जरी से पहले गुर्दे की विफलता वाले रोगी को अक्सर किस प्रक्रिया की आवश्यकता होती है?
e: Dialysis is necessary when kidneys cannot remove waste and excess fluid from the body. Dialysis removes the waste products and the extra fluid, and the patient may need it two or three times a week.

qe: In 'Valvular Heart Disease', the main problem is with:
qh: 'वाल्वुलर हार्ट डिजीज' में मुख्य समस्या किसके साथ होती है?
o: Heart valves (Mitral, Aortic, etc.) | हृदय के वाल्व
e: Valvular heart disease involves damage to any of the four valves that control blood flow. The affected valve does not open or close properly, so the blood flow is obstructed or leaks backwards.

qe: Which sign is a characteristic of 'Pulmonary Tuberculosis'?
qh: 'पल्मोनरी ट्यूबरकुलोसिस' (फेफड़ों की टीबी) की विशेषता क्या है?
o: Chronic cough and Hemoptysis | पुरानी खांसी और बलगम में खून
e: Tuberculosis of the lungs often presents with a persistent cough for more than 2-3 weeks. Evening rise of temperature, night sweats, chest pain and loss of weight are common along with the cough.

qe: What happens to the heart's pumping ability in 'Heart Failure'?
qh: 'हार्ट फेल्योर' में हृदय की पंपिंग क्षमता का क्या होता है?
o: It becomes inadequate to meet body needs | शरीर की जरूरतों के लिए अपर्याप्त
e: Heart failure means the heart muscle doesn't pump blood as well as it should. Because the pump is weak, blood backs up in the lungs and legs, causing breathlessness and swelling.

qe: Which of the following is a common symptom of 'C.O.P.D.'?
qh: 'C.O.P.D.' का एक सामान्य लक्षण निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा है?
o: Shortness of breath (Dyspnea) | सांस की तकलीफ
e: COPD patients often struggle with chronic airflow limitation and breathing difficulty. The patient has a chronic cough with sputum and breathing difficulty that becomes worse on exertion and in winter.

qe: Why is 'History Taking' important for a patient with diabetes before surgery?
qh: सर्जरी से पहले मधुमेह वाले रोगी के लिए 'इतिहास लेना' क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है?
o: To know about their insulin dosage and timing | इंसुलिन की खुराक और समय जानना
e: Knowing the medication history helps in managing blood sugar during the perioperative period.

qe: Which part of the body can be affected by TB other than lungs?
qh: फेफड़ों के अलावा शरीर का कौन सा हिस्सा टीबी से प्रभावित हो सकता है?
o: Intestine and Bone | आंत और हड्डी
e: Extra-pulmonary tuberculosis can affect bones, intestines, and other organs. It can involve the lymph nodes, bones, kidneys, brain coverings and intestines, and it is then called extrapulmonary tuberculosis.

qe: What is the main concern in 'Neurological diseases' for O.T. assistants?
qh: ओ.टी. सहायकों के लिए 'न्यूरोलॉजिकल रोगों' में मुख्य चिंता क्या है?
o: Altered consciousness and motor function | चेतना और मोटर फंक्शन में बदलाव
e: Neurological status affects the patient's stability and airway management. A patient with fits or muscle weakness needs protection of the airway, careful position and continuous monitoring.

qe: Monitoring 'Pulse and Blood Pressure' is essential to detect:
qh: 'पल्स और ब्लड प्रेशर' की निगरानी किसका पता लगाने के लिए आवश्यक है?
o: Shock and Hemorrhage | शॉक और रक्तस्राव
e: Vital signs are the first indicators of clinical deterioration. A rise in pulse with a fall in blood pressure is an early sign of shock, so the technician must inform the anaesthetist at once.

qe: Which organism causes 'Typhoid Fever'?
qh: 'टाइफाइड बुखार' का कारण कौन सा जीव है?
e: Typhoid is a bacterial infection spread through contaminated food and water. It is caused by Salmonella typhi, and the infection enters the body through contaminated water, milk or food.

qe: What is the mode of transmission for 'Hepatitis-B'?
qh: 'हेपेटाइटिस-बी' के संचरण का तरीका क्या है?
o: Blood and body fluids | रक्त और शरीर के तरल पदार्थ
e: Hepatitis-B is highly infectious and spreads through infected blood, needles, and body fluids.

qe: The 'HIV' virus primarily attacks which system of the human body?
qh: 'एचआईवी' वायरस मुख्य रूप से मानव शरीर के किस तंत्र पर हमला करता है?
e: HIV attacks the CD4 cells, weakening the body's ability to fight infections and diseases. The virus binds to the CD4 helper cells and slowly destroys them, which is why the body cannot fight even simple infections.

qe: What clinical sign is characterized by the yellowish discoloration of the skin and eyes?
qh: त्वचा और आंखों के पीलेपन की विशेषता वाला नैदानिक लक्षण क्या है?
e: Jaundice is often a sign of liver diseases like Hepatitis. The yellow colour is seen first in the eyes and then spreads to the skin and the urine.

qe: In medical examination, 'Pallor' (paleness) is an indicator of:
qh: चिकित्सा परीक्षण में, 'पेलर' (पीलापन) किसका सूचक है?
e: Pallor is the pale appearance of the skin or mucous membranes, often due to low hemoglobin.

qe: Why is knowledge of HIV/AIDS critical for O.T. Technicians?
qh: ओ.टी. तकनीशियनों के लिए एचआईवी/एड्स का ज्ञान क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है?
o: To follow universal precautions and prevent needle-stick injuries | सुरक्षा सावधानी और बचाव के लिए
e: Understanding HIV is vital for maintaining O.T. safety and preventing cross-contamination.

qe: Which of the following is a sign of 'Respiratory Distress'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'श्वसन संकट' (Respiratory Distress) का संकेत है?
e: Cyanosis indicates poor oxygenation and is a sign of severe respiratory or cardiac issues.

qe: What is 'Chronic' disease?
qh: 'क्रोनिक' (Chronic) रोग क्या है?
o: A disease that lasts for a short time
A long-lasting condition | लंबे समय तक चलने वाली स्थिति
e: Chronic diseases like COPD or Diabetes persist for long periods and require continuous management.

qe: The term 'Oedema' refers to:
qh: 'एडिमा' (Oedema) शब्द का तात्पर्य है:
o: Fluid accumulation in tissues causing swelling | सूजन
e: Oedema is common in renal and heart failure patients. It occurs when the fluid leaving the blood vessels is more than the lymph vessels can drain away.

qe: Which diagnostic sign helps in assessing blood circulation in the extremities?
qh: हाथ-पैरों में रक्त परिसंचरण का आकलन करने में कौन सा नैदानिक संकेत मदद करता है?
e: Checking the peripheral pulse is a standard part of physical examination to assess circulation.

qe: Which hormone deficiency is the primary cause of Diabetes Mellitus?
qh: मधुमेह (Diabetes Mellitus) का प्राथमिक कारण किस हार्मोन की कमी है?
e: Diabetes is caused by the pancreas' inability to produce enough insulin or the body's inability to use it effectively.

qe: What is the clinical term for 'Renal Failure'?
qh: 'गुर्दे की विफलता' के लिए नैदानिक शब्द क्या है?
e: Renal failure occurs when kidneys lose the ability to filter waste products from the blood.

qe: Which vital sign is most critical to monitor in a patient with 'Hypertension'?
qh: 'हाइपरटेंशन' के मरीज में किस वाइटल साइन की निगरानी सबसे महत्वपूर्ण है?
e: Hypertension refers to high blood pressure, which must be monitored to prevent complications during surgery.

qe: What does 'C.O.P.D.' stand for in respiratory medicine?
qh: श्वसन चिकित्सा में 'C.O.P.D.' का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease | क्रोनिक ऑब्स्ट्रक्टिव पल्मोनरी डिजीज
e: COPD is a chronic inflammatory lung disease that causes obstructed airflow from the lungs.

qe: A patient with 'Heart Failure' may show which of the following signs?
qh: 'हार्ट फेल्योर' वाले मरीज में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा लक्षण दिखाई दे सकता है?
e: Peripheral oedema or swelling in the legs is a common sign of congestive heart failure. Swelling of the ankles, breathlessness on lying down and weight gain are typical features of congestive heart failure.

qe: Which condition is characterized by the inflammation of the liver, often caused by a virus?
qh: लीवर की सूजन, जो अक्सर वायरस के कारण होती है, किस स्थिति की विशेषता है?
e: Hepatitis is an inflammatory condition of the liver, with Hepatitis-B being a major concern in O.T.

qe: The importance of history taking in a medical patient include:
qh: एक मेडिकल मरीज में इतिहास लेने (History taking) के महत्व में शामिल है:
o: To identify pre-existing diseases and allergies | पहले से मौजूद बीमारियों की पहचान
e: A brief history helps the O.T. team prepare for potential medical emergencies during surgery.

qe: Which disease is caused by 'Mycobacterium tuberculosis'?
qh: 'माइकोबैक्टीरियम ट्यूबरकुलोसिस' के कारण कौन सा रोग होता है?
e: TB primarily affects the lungs but can also involve bones and intestines. The infection spreads through droplets when the patient coughs, and it mainly involves the lungs.

qe: A 'Valvular heart disease' affects which part of the heart?
qh: 'वाल्वुलर हार्ट डिजीज' हृदय के किस भाग को प्रभावित करती है?
e: It occurs when one or more of the heart valves do not function properly. The valves act like gates, and when they are damaged the heart has to work harder to push blood through them.

qe: In a diabetic patient, what is the risk of 'Hypoglycemia' during surgery?
qh: एक मधुमेह रोगी में, सर्जरी के दौरान 'हाइपोग्लाइसीमिया' का क्या जोखिम है?
o: Dangerously low blood sugar | खतरनाक रूप से कम ब्लड शुगर
e: Hypoglycemia is a medical emergency that can occur if the patient is fasting for surgery but has taken insulin.

qe: Under the 'Consumer Protection Act', an O.T. Technician can be held liable for:
qh: 'उपभोक्ता संरक्षण अधिनियम' के तहत, एक ओ.टी. तकनीशियन को किसके लिए उत्तरदायी ठहराया जा सकता है?
o: Medical negligence or lack of care | मेडिकल लापरवाही या देखभाल में कमी
e: Technicians have legal responsibilities for patient safety during their care. The patient can claim compensation if injury is proved to be due to negligence, so proper records must always be kept.

qe: What is the 'Moral duty' of an O.T. Technician toward fellow technicians?
qh: साथी तकनीशियनों के प्रति ओ.टी. तकनीशियन का 'नैतिक कर्तव्य' क्या है?
o: Cooperation and professional respect | सहयोग और पेशेवर सम्मान
e: Teamwork and mutual respect are essential for the high-pressure O.T. environment. Helping colleagues, keeping calm in an emergency and never hiding a mistake are part of this duty.

qe: A student of the Diploma in O.T. Assistant course must be on duty during holidays if:
qh: डिप्लोमा इन ओ.टी. असिस्टेंट कोर्स के छात्र को छुट्टियों के दौरान ड्यूटी पर होना चाहिए यदि:
o: The O.T. is functioning | यदि ओ.टी. कार्य कर रहा है
e: The clinical training continues regardless of holidays if surgeries are scheduled. Clinical posting gives hands-on practice that no book can give, so attendance and punctuality are compulsory for the student.

qe: The 'Movement Register' in the O.T. is used for:
qh: ओ.टी. में 'मूवमेंट रजिस्टर' (Movement Register) का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
o: Recording entry/exit of staff or equipment | स्टाफ या उपकरणों के आने-जाने का रिकॉर्ड
e: It helps in tracking the flow of personnel and materials for security and management. Every person entering or leaving the O.T. complex signs the register, which also records the time and purpose of the visit.

qe: Coordination with 'Drug supply units' ensures:
qh: 'ड्रग सप्लाई यूनिट' के साथ समन्वय क्या सुनिश्चित करता है?
o: Availability of necessary emergency and routine drugs | आवश्यक दवाओं की उपलब्धता
e: The O.T. must never run out of critical medications during a procedure. The indent is sent in advance and the stock is checked, so that emergency drugs like adrenaline and atropine are always at hand.

qe: What is the purpose of 'Post-operative oxygenation' nursing care?
qh: 'पोस्ट-ऑपरेटिव ऑक्सीजनेशन' नर्सिंग केयर का उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: To maintain adequate oxygen levels after anesthesia | पर्याप्त ऑक्सीजन स्तर बनाए रखना
e: Anesthesia can depress respiration, requiring supplemental oxygen during recovery. Oxygen is given by mask or nasal prongs and the saturation is watched till the patient is fully awake.

qe: Which document is essential for the 'Auditing' process of O.T. expenses?
qh: ओ.टी. खर्चों की 'ऑडिटिंग' प्रक्रिया के लिए कौन सा दस्तावेज आवश्यक है?
o: Indent and Stock registers | इंडेंट और स्टॉक रजिस्टर
e: Accurate records of supplies and usage are needed for financial and administrative audits.

qe: Maintaining 'O.T. Discipline' includes:
qh: 'ओ.टी. अनुशासन' बनाए रखने में शामिल है:
o: Strict adherence to sterile protocols and noise control | स्टेराइल प्रोटोकॉल का पालन और शोर नियंत्रण
e: Discipline is fundamental to maintaining a sterile environment and focus. This includes punctuality, correct dress, silence, avoiding unnecessary movement and following the instructions of the theatre sister.

qe: The 'Circular File' is used to keep:
qh: 'सर्कुलर फाइल' (Circular File) का उपयोग किसे रखने के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Official notices and guidelines | आधिकारिक नोटिस और दिशा-निर्देश
e: It ensures that all staff are informed about the latest administrative or clinical protocols.

qe: Why is 'Physical Examination' of pulse and BP important for O.T. Technicians to know?
qh: ओ.टी. तकनीशियन के लिए पल्स और बीपी की 'शारीरिक जांच' जानना क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है?
o: To assist in monitoring patient stability | मरीज की स्थिरता की निगरानी में मदद करना
e: Constant vigilance of vital signs allows for rapid response to emergencies. The trend of the readings is more useful than a single value, so they are written on a chart at fixed intervals.

qe: What is the primary risk of using a 'Monopolar Cautery' if the patient plate is not properly attached?
qh: यदि पेशेंट प्लेट ठीक से नहीं लगी है, तो 'मोनोपोलर कॉटरी' के उपयोग का प्राथमिक जोखिम क्या है?
e: A loose or poorly placed return electrode (patient plate) can cause accidental electrical burns at the contact site.

qe: During long surgeries, why is it critical to prevent the 'Free fall of arms or legs'?
qh: लंबी सर्जरी के दौरान, हाथ या पैर के 'फ्री फॉल' को रोकना क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है?
o: To prevent nerve injury and dislocations | तंत्रिका चोट और अव्यवस्था को रोकना
e: Unsupported limbs can lead to nerve stretching or pressure palsies and joint injuries. The arms and legs are secured in a natural position on arm boards and straps, with padding at the pressure points.

qe: How should an O.T. technician care for a 'Surgical Drain' during patient transfer?
qh: मरीज के ट्रांसफर के दौरान ओ.टी. तकनीशियन को 'सर्जिकल ड्रेन' की देखभाल कैसे करनी चाहिए?
o: Ensure it is not kinked or pulled and remains below the wound level | सुनिश्चित करें कि यह मुड़ा या खिंचा न हो
e: Drains must be handled carefully to maintain their function and prevent accidental removal.

qe: What is the risk of 'Electrocution' in the O.T. primarily linked to?
qh: ओ.टी. में 'इलेक्ट्रोक्यूशन' (बिजली का झटका) का जोखिम मुख्य रूप से किससे जुड़ा है?
o: Liquid spills on electrical equipment | बिजली के उपकरणों पर तरल का गिरना
e: Saline or blood spills on ungrounded electrical equipment can cause fatal electric shocks.

qe: Which part of the body requires special protection against 'Pressure sores' during a 5-hour surgery?
qh: 5 घंटे की सर्जरी के दौरान शरीर के किस हिस्से को 'प्रेशर सोर' से विशेष सुरक्षा की आवश्यकता होती है?
o: Bony prominences like heels and sacrum | एड़ी और त्रिकास्थि जैसे हड्डी वाले हिस्से
e: Prolonged pressure on bony areas reduces blood flow, leading to decubitus ulcers. The skin over the sacrum, heels, elbows and back of the head is the most vulnerable, so foam pads are used at these points.

qe: Post-operative dressing and bandaging of the 'Scrotum' requires:
qh: 'अंडकोश' (Scrotum) की पोस्ट-ऑपरेटिव ड्रेसिंग और बैंडेजिंग के लिए आवश्यक है:
o: T-bandage or Scrotal support | टी-बैंडेज या स्क्रोटल सपोर्ट
e: Specific areas like the scrotum require specialized bandaging to provide support and reduce edema.

qe: Coordination with 'Water, Electric, and Gas supply units' is the duty of:
qh: पानी, बिजली और गैस आपूर्ति इकाइयों के साथ समन्वय करना किसका कर्तव्य है?
e: Ensuring uninterrupted utility supplies is vital for a functional and safe O.T. environment.

qe: During operation, 'Eye care' for a general anesthesia patient involves:
qh: ऑपरेशन के दौरान, जनरल एनेस्थीसिया वाले मरीज के लिए 'आई केयर' में शामिल है:
o: Taping the eyelids closed | पलकों को टेप से बंद करना
e: Closing the eyes prevents corneal drying and accidental injury during surgery. The lids are closed with a tape or an ointment is applied, and this care is noted in the nursing record.

qe: Which register is used to maintain a record of all surgical instruments in the O.T.?
qh: ओ.टी. में सभी सर्जिकल उपकरणों का रिकॉर्ड रखने के लिए किस रजिस्टर का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: The stock register tracks the inventory and availability of all O.T. equipment. It shows the balance of sterile packs, sutures, gloves and implants, and helps the in-charge to indent fresh stock.

qe: What is the O.T. Technician's role in maintaining 'Law and Order' in the O.T. complex?
qh: ओ.टी. कॉम्प्लेक्स में 'कानून और व्यवस्था' बनाए रखने में ओ.टी. तकनीशियन की क्या भूमिका है?
o: Maintaining strict O.T. discipline and restricted entry | अनुशासन और प्रतिबंधित प्रवेश बनाए रखना
e: Strict discipline is necessary to ensure safety and prevent unauthorized access. No unauthorised person may enter the theatre, and any accident or dispute must be reported to the in-charge at once.

qe: Which anesthesia technique involves injecting medicine into the cerebrospinal fluid?
qh: किस एनेस्थीसिया तकनीक में दवा को मस्तिष्कमेरु द्रव (CSF) में इंजेक्ट किया जाता है?
e: Spinal anesthesia involves injecting local anesthetics into the subarachnoid space. It is used for lower abdominal, pelvic and lower limb surgery, and the patient stays awake during the operation.

qe: What is the common use of 'Nitrous Oxide' in the O.T.?
qh: ओ.टी. में 'नाइट्रस ऑक्साइड' का सामान्य उपयोग क्या है?
o: Inhalation anesthetic gas | सूंघने वाली एनेस्थेटिक गैस
e: Nitrous oxide is a widely used inhalation gas during general anesthesia. It is a colourless gas given along with oxygen, and it gives good pain relief with quick recovery.

qe: Which organ is bypassed during Open Heart Surgery?
qh: ओपन हार्ट सर्जरी के दौरान किस अंग को बायपास किया जाता है?
o: Heart and Lungs | हृदय और फेफड़े
e: A heart-lung machine takes over the function of these organs during cardiac surgery. The machine temporarily takes over the work of the heart and the lungs and keeps the blood oxygenated during the operation.

qe: The primary purpose of 'Pre-anaesthetic medication' is:
qh: 'प्री-एनेस्थेटिक मेडिकेशन' का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य है:
o: To reduce anxiety and secretions | चिंता और स्राव को कम करना
e: Pre-medication calms the patient and prepares the body for anesthesia. Drugs such as atropine, an antiemetic and a sedative are given to reduce secretions, prevent vomiting and lessen anxiety.

qe: Which position is used for Thyroid surgery?
qh: थायराइड की सर्जरी के लिए किस पोजीशन का उपयोग किया जाता है?
o: Supine with neck extended | गर्दन को बढ़ाकर सुपाइन स्थिति
e: Extending the neck provides proper exposure for thyroid and related neck surgeries. A pillow is placed under the shoulders and the head is extended and often turned, which gives a clear view of the gland.

qe: Which medical condition is a priority concern during anesthesia due to insulin imbalance?
qh: इंसुलिन असंतुलन के कारण एनेस्थीसिया के दौरान कौन सी मेडिकल स्थिति प्राथमिकता वाली चिंता है?
e: Blood sugar levels must be strictly monitored in diabetic patients during surgery. Very high or very low sugar can be dangerous during surgery, so the level is checked before and during the operation.

qe: What does 'Artificial Ventilation' refer to?
qh: 'कृत्रिम वेंटिलेशन' (Artificial Ventilation) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Mechanical support for breathing | श्वसन के लिए यांत्रिक सहायता
e: Mechanical ventilators are used when patients cannot breathe on their own. A machine called the ventilator pushes a fixed volume of air at a set rate through the tube or mask.

qe: The use of 'Casts and Slabs' is common in which specialty?
qh: 'कास्ट और स्लैब' का उपयोग किस विशेषता में आम है?
e: Casts and slabs are used to immobilize fractured bones in orthopaedics. They are applied after the fracture is set and are also used after some operations to keep the limb still.

qe: What is the 'Indenting procedure' in O.T. management?
qh: ओ.टी. प्रबंधन में 'इंडेन्टिंग प्रक्रिया' (Indenting procedure) क्या है?
o: Requesting for drug and supply units | दवाओं और आपूर्ति की मांग करना
e: Indenting is the formal way to request stock and supplies from the hospital store. The store in-charge then issues the items, and the entry is made in the stock register.

qe: Post-anaesthesia nursing care for 'Patent Airway' ensures:
qh: 'पेटेंट एयरवे' के लिए पोस्ट-एनेस्थीसिया नर्सिंग देखभाल क्या सुनिश्चित करती है?
e: It prevents tongue fall or obstruction that can lead to suffocation. The head is turned to one side, the chin is lifted and any secretion or vomit is sucked out.

qe: Which part of the sterile gown is considered 'Unsterile'?
qh: स्टेराइल गाउन का कौन सा हिस्सा 'अनस्टेराइल' माना जाता है?
o: Back of the gown | गाउन का पिछला हिस्सा
e: The back of the gown is considered unsterile because it cannot be constantly monitored by the wearer.

qe: What is the primary reason for 'Ryle's tube' insertion before abdominal surgery?
qh: पेट की सर्जरी से पहले 'राइल्स ट्यूब' डालने का प्राथमिक कारण क्या है?
o: To decompress the stomach | पेट को डिकम्प्रेस (खाली) करना
e: Ryle's tube is used for gastric decompression to prevent aspiration during or after surgery.

qe: Which position is used for Rectal and Perineal operations?
qh: मलाशय (Rectal) और पेरिनियल ऑपरेशन के लिए किस पोजीशन का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Lithotomy position provides the best exposure for surgeries involving the perineum and rectum.

qe: The 'Trendelenburg' position is used to improve blood flow to:
qh: 'ट्रेंडलेनबर्ग' पोजीशन का उपयोग किसके रक्त प्रवाह को सुधारने के लिए किया जाता है?
o: Brain and Heart (in shock) | मस्तिष्क और हृदय
e: This head-down position helps in returning blood to vital organs during shock or hypotension.

qe: What should be checked first when a patient is transferred to the Recovery Room?
qh: जब मरीज को रिकवरी रूम में ट्रांसफर किया जाता है, तो सबसे पहले क्या जांचना चाहिए?
o: Patent airway | श्वसन मार्ग (Airway) की स्पष्टता
e: Maintaining a patent airway is the top priority in post-operative nursing care. Then the pulse, the blood pressure, the drain and the dressing are checked and the patient is covered with a blanket.

qe: What is the recommended method for sterilizing sharp surgical instruments like scalpels?
qh: स्केलपेल जैसे नुकीले सर्जिकल उपकरणों को स्टरलाइज करने की अनुशंसित विधि क्या है?
o: Chemical sterilization or Autoclave | रासायनिक स्टरलाइजेशन या ऑटोक्लेव
e: Sharps are sterilized using high-level disinfectants or autoclaving with proper care. They are first cleaned of blood, then packed in the prescribed container, and the autoclave cycle is recorded.

qe: The legal act that protects patient rights in the medical field is:
qh: मेडिकल क्षेत्र में मरीज के अधिकारों की रक्षा करने वाला कानूनी अधिनियम है:
o: Consumer Protection Act | उपभोक्ता संरक्षण अधिनियम
e: The Consumer Protection Act covers legal responsibilities regarding patient care in the O.T.

qe: What is 'Tachycardia' in vital signs monitoring?
qh: वाइटल साइन्स मॉनिटरिंग में 'टैकीकार्डिया' (Tachycardia) क्या है?
o: Rapid heart rate | तेज हृदय गति
e: A heart rate significantly higher than normal (usually >100 bpm) is termed tachycardia. It may be caused by fever, pain, blood loss, anxiety or certain drugs, and the cause must be looked for.

qe: The use of an 'Endoscopy room' is for:
qh: 'एंडोस्कोपी रूम' का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
o: Viewing internal organs using a camera | कैमरा द्वारा आंतरिक अंगों को देखना
e: Endoscopy is a minimally invasive procedure to view internal body cavities. It needs proper disinfection of the scopes and a dark room for viewing the images on the monitor.

qe: A 'Log book' in the O.T. complex is used for:
qh: ओ.टी. कॉम्प्लेक्स में 'लॉग बुक' (Log book) का उपयोग किसके लिए किया जाता है?
o: Maintaining records of work done | किए गए कार्यों का रिकॉर्ड रखना
e: Technicians must maintain a log book to document daily procedures and equipment use. The entries help in auditing, in keeping a record of the instruments used and in tracing any untoward event.

qe: Which drug is used as a 'Pre-anaesthetic medication' to reduce secretions?
qh: स्राव (secretions) को कम करने के लिए प्री-एनेस्थेटिक दवा के रूप में किसका उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Atropine reduces salivary and bronchial secretions to keep the airway clear during anesthesia.

qe: The 'Saddle Block' is a type of:
qh: 'सैडल ब्लॉक' (Saddle Block) किसका एक प्रकार है?
e: Saddle block is a low spinal anesthesia used for perineal or gynecological surgeries. It is a low spinal block in which only the part of the body that would touch a saddle becomes numb.

qe: Which position is required for spinal anesthesia?
qh: स्पाइनल एनेस्थीसिया देने के लिए किस पोजीशन की आवश्यकता होती है?
o: Lateral or Sitting with arched back | पार्श्व या झुककर बैठने की स्थिति
e: The spine must be flexed to open up the intervertebral spaces for needle insertion. The patient sits or lies on the side with the chin on the chest and the knees drawn up, so that the spaces between the vertebrae open.

qe: The primary role of an O.T. technician during cardiac arrest in O.T. is:
qh: ओ.टी. में कार्डियक अरेस्ट के दौरान तकनीशियन की प्राथमिक भूमिका है:
o: To assist in CPR and provide emergency equipment | सीपीआर में मदद और आपातकालीन उपकरण देना
e: Technicians must be ready with defibrillators and cardiac drugs for immediate management. While the doctor gives the drug, the technician keeps the chest compressions going and notes the time of each step.

qe: Used surgical gloves and linen should be processed in which room?
qh: उपयोग किए गए सर्जिकल ग्लव्स और लिनन को किस कमरे में संसाधित किया जाना चाहिए?
o: Washing & Packing room | धुलाई और पैकिंग रूम
e: Decontamination, washing, and packing must be done before the next sterilization cycle. Used items are never sent straight to the packing room, because that would contaminate the clean material.

qe: Which incision is typically used for Appendectomy?
qh: अपेंडिसेक्टोमी (Appendectomy) के लिए आमतौर पर कौन सा चीरा लगाया जाता है?
e: McBurney's incision is a specific abdominal incision used to access the appendix. It is placed over the point of maximum tenderness in the right lower abdomen, and it gives a good view with little muscle damage.

qe: What is the antidote for muscle relaxants?
qh: मांसपेशी रिलैक्सेंट्स (Muscle relaxants) का मारक (Antidote) क्या है?
e: Neostigmine is used to reverse the effects of non-depolarizing muscle relaxants. It is given along with an anticholinergic drug such as glycopyrrolate to prevent a slow heart rate and excessive secretions.

qe: Handling, preserving and transporting samples from O.T. to lab is the responsibility of:
qh: ओ.टी. से लैब तक नमूनों को संभालना, सुरक्षित रखना और पहुँचाना किसकी जिम्मेदारी है?
e: Technicians must ensure specimens like tissue or stones are sent in correct containers (like Formalin).

qe: Post-operative nursing care for vomiting includes:
qh: उल्टी (vomiting) के लिए पोस्ट-ऑपरेटिव नर्सिंग देखभाल में शामिल है:
o: Turning the patient's head to one side | मरीज का सिर एक तरफ घुमाना
e: Turning the head prevents aspiration of vomit into the lungs (aspiration pneumonia). The patient is also kept without food till the vomiting stops, and the doctor is informed if it continues.

qe: Which organization's legal responsibilities apply to O.T. patient care?
qh: ओ.टी. मरीज की देखभाल पर किस संगठन की कानूनी जिम्मेदारियां लागू होती हैं?
