o: Consumer Protection Act | उपभोक्ता संरक्षण अधिनियम
e: O.T. technicians are legally responsible for any negligence under the Consumer Protection Act.

qe: Which gas is commonly used for O.T. fumigation?
qh: ओ.टी. के धूमीकरण (Fumigation) के लिए आमतौर पर किस गैस का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Formaldehyde is a strong disinfectant used to sterilize the air and surfaces in an O.T. complex.

qe: A sudden drop in blood pressure and rapid pulse after surgery may indicate:
qh: सर्जरी के बाद रक्तचाप में अचानक गिरावट और तेज़ नाड़ी किसका संकेत हो सकती है?
o: Shock or Hemorrhage | शॉक या रक्तस्राव
e: Tachycardia and hypotension are clinical signs of internal bleeding or postoperative shock.

qe: What is the correct method to open a sterile wrapped packing?
qh: स्टेराइल रैप्ड पैकिंग खोलने का सही तरीका क्या है?
o: Open away from yourself | अपने से दूर की तरफ खोलना
e: Opening away from the body prevents accidental contamination of the sterile field. The outer wrapper is peeled back and the inner sterile part is lifted with forceps or sterile gloves and never touched by bare hands.

qe: Which vital sign indicates 'Cyanosis'?
qh: कौन सा 'वाइटल साइन' साइनोसिस की पहचान है?
o: Blue discoloration of skin/lips | त्वचा या होठों का नीला पड़ना
e: Cyanosis is a sign of inadequate oxygenation of the blood. It becomes visible when the oxygen saturation falls markedly, and it calls for increasing the oxygen supply.

qe: Decubitus ulcer during long operations can be prevented by:
qh: लंबी सर्जरी के दौरान डेक्यूबिटस अल्सर (Bed sores) को कैसे रोका जा सकता है?
o: Frequent padding of pressure points | दबाव बिंदुओं पर पैडिंग लगाना
e: Proper positioning and use of pads prevent tissue ischemia during prolonged immobilization on the table.

qe: Insertion of a tube through the nose into the stomach is called:
qh: नाक के माध्यम से पेट में ट्यूब डालने की प्रक्रिया कहलाती है:
o: Ryle's tube insertion | राइल्स ट्यूब इंसर्शन
e: Ryle's tube is used for feeding or gastric decompression in pre/post-operative patients. It may be left in place for feeding, for giving drugs or for removing gas and fluid from the stomach.

qe: Moral and ethical duties of an O.T. Technician include:
qh: ओ.टी. तकनीशियन के नैतिक कर्तव्यों में शामिल है:
o: Maintaining patient confidentiality and discipline | गोपनीयता और अनुशासन बनाए रखना
e: Professional ethics require strict discipline and legal responsibility for patient care. These duties include maintaining sterility, respecting the patient's privacy, keeping records confidential and reporting every error.

qe: What is the full form of C.S.S.D. in a hospital?
qh: अस्पताल में C.S.S.D. का पूरा नाम क्या है?
o: Central Sterile Supply Department | केंद्रीय निर्जर्मीकरण आपूर्ति विभाग
e: The C.S.S.D. receives used instruments and linen, cleans them, packs them, sterilises them in autoclaves and supplies the sterile packs to the operation theatres and wards. It works as the central unit that keeps a check on the sterilisation cycle, the date of packing and the expiry of every pack. A clean and well-run C.S.S.D. is the backbone of infection control in the hospital.

qe: Which of the following is the main function of the C.S.S.D.?
qh: निम्न में से C.S.S.D. का मुख्य कार्य कौन सा है?
o: To clean, pack, sterilise and supply sterile items to the O.T. and wards | साफ करना, पैक करना, निर्जर्मीकरण करना और आपूर्ति करना
To purchase medicines for the hospital
To maintain the salary records of staff
e: Used instruments, gloves, gowns and drapes are first decontaminated, then washed, dried, checked, packed and finally sterilised. After sterilisation the packs are stored on racks with the date and the batch number and then issued to the operation theatre and wards to meet the daily demand. This cycle removes the chance of infection passing from one patient to another.

qe: Blood-soaked gauze and used dressings from the O.T. are thrown into which bag?
qh: ऑपरेशन थियेटर के खून से भीगे गॉज और प्रयुक्त ड्रेसिंग किस बैग में डाली जाती है?
e: Blood-soaked gauze, used dressings, amputated parts and soiled linen are human anatomical and soiled waste, so they go into the yellow bag and are sent for incineration or deep burial. Contaminated plastic items such as gloves and tubing go into the red bag, while sharps go into the puncture-proof white container. Mixing the bags is a punishable offence and defeats the purpose of segregation.

qe: Before using an electrocautery (diathermy) during surgery, which safety step is most important?
qh: सर्जरी के दौरान इलेक्ट्रोकॉटरी (डायथर्मी) का उपयोग करने से पहले कौन सा सुरक्षा कदम सबसे जरूरी है?
o: Fixing the patient return electrode plate firmly on a fleshy, dry area | वापसी इलेक्ट्रोड प्लेट को मांसल और सूखे हिस्से पर ठीक से लगाना
Wetting the operation sheet with spirit
Loosening the plate after every cut
e: The return electrode or diathermy plate gives the current a safe path back to the machine, so it must lie flat and firm on a dry, fleshy part such as the thigh. A loose plate, wet drapes or pooled spirit near the cautery tip can cause burns or even a theatre fire. Alcoholic antiseptics are allowed to dry fully before the cautery is used.

qe: During a blood transfusion in the O.T., which reaction requires the transfusion to be stopped immediately?
qh: ऑपरेशन थियेटर में रक्त चढ़ाते समय किस प्रतिक्रिया पर ट्रांसफ्यूजन तुरंत रोक देना चाहिए?
o: Fever with chills, back pain and restlessness | बुखार के साथ कंपकंपी, कमर दर्द और बेचैनी
e: Fever with chills, pain in the back or flanks, a fall in blood pressure and dark urine point to a haemolytic reaction, that is, the donor blood is being destroyed by the patient's antibodies. The transfusion is stopped at once, the unit with its tubing is kept for testing, the doctor is informed and the patient is treated with fluids and drugs. Most such reactions are due to an error in matching or labelling of the blood unit.

qe: In the O.T., if fire breaks out near an electrical machine, which type of extinguisher is safest to use?
qh: ऑपरेशन थियेटर में यदि बिजली के उपकरण के पास आग लग जाए तो किस प्रकार का अग्निशामक सबसे सुरक्षित है?
o: Carbon dioxide (CO2) extinguisher | कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड अग्निशामक
e: Carbon dioxide cuts off the oxygen supply and does not conduct electricity, so it is the correct choice for fires involving electrical equipment and gases. Water can give an electric shock to the user and can also react with chemicals. The O.T. staff must know the position of the alarm, the extinguishers and the emergency exit before every list.
